metadata.title: AIG Chairman Peter Zaffino to Step Down, Join Palantir - WSJ

content.text:
American International Group’s executive chairman, Peter Zaffino, is stepping down from the insurer’s board and will join data-analytics company Palantir Technologies PLTR -3.47%decrease; down pointing triangle as global head of financial services.
AIG AIG -0.63%decrease; down pointing triangle on Wednesday said Zaffino will leave the board on Sept. 15, and that John Rice, a board member since March 2022 who currently serves as the New York company’s lead independent director, will succeed him as chairman.
